subthemes.name: Making models smaller and faster
subthemes.gist: These papers shrink neural networks and reduce computation by removing unneeded weights, simplifying math, or using lower precision numbers while keeping the model smart.

subthemes.name: Splitting work across many machines
subthemes.gist: These papers tackle the challenge of training and running models on multiple computers together, deciding which machine handles which part, and keeping performance good even when machines have different capabilities.

subthemes.name: Smarter attention to save memory
subthemes.gist: These papers speed up the attention mechanism—a core bottleneck in transformers—by using sparse patterns, linear tricks, or clever reuse of cached values instead of computing everything.

subthemes.name: Efficient training with fewer parameters
subthemes.gist: These papers make fine-tuning much cheaper by only updating a small part of a model instead of all weights, using rank-based tricks or clever decompositions.

subthemes.name: Faster inference through clever prediction
subthemes.gist: These papers speed up how fast a model generates answers by predicting what comes next, reusing previous work, or trying multiple paths in parallel then picking the best one.

subthemes.name: Neural networks that mimic the brain
subthemes.gist: These papers use spiking neural networks inspired by biology—neurons that fire only when needed—to save power and memory compared to traditional neural networks.

subthemes.name: Smart token management for long context
subthemes.gist: These papers reduce the memory explosion when models process very long documents by deciding which tokens matter most and keeping only those, or using clever ways to summarize.

subthemes.name: Fast diffusion models for images and video
subthemes.gist: These papers speed up diffusion models—generative systems that improve images step by step—through clever attention, sparse computation, or orthogonal tricks to make them practical.
